coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn rules (cand/b088.json); "o" tick boxes measured as ink at 400 dpi; spaces measured between the words around them; every page looked at; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Subscription agreement for a limited partnership (SQN AIF III). The subscriber completes pages C-5/C-6, initials eight statements, and signs in one of two identical signature blocks (a second for a joint subscriber); the general partner accepts on C-7; a tax certification (C-10) and an optional electronic-delivery consent (C-11) follow.
signing.note: Tick boxes are printed as the letter "o". Several blanks lost their rules in the filing (amounts, country, grantor-trust percentages): kept as spaces, marked.

sure_per_page.6: sure; the three investment amounts and the country have no printed rule (blank spaces, marked)
sure_per_page.7: sure of every place; the 16 initials are spaces inside parentheses; dates share the signature rules (marked)
sure_per_page.11: sure; the four (c) blanks are spaces with no rule (marked)
sure_per_page.12: sure; the signature and date share one rule (split, marked)
